label: D1 after a common a1->S1 trial, strongest when unrewarded after a reward; fades over episode
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (tv("action", -2) == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == -9)
explanation: Active only at D1 (zero at GO/D2). Magnitude is set by the previous trial: after a common a1->S1 trial it is high, otherwise near zero (other last-trial patterns are about -0.07 vs timing). Unrewarded a1 S1 gives the biggest response (about +0.34 vs timing, up to ~1.2), and much more so if the trial before was rewarded (+0.36) or lies outside the window; it drops toward 0 after a run of unrewarded trials. Rewarded a1 S1 gives a smaller response that builds up over consecutive a1 S1 trials (+0.10 if the trial before was also a1 S1). Both responses get weaker later in the episode (negative ep_trial slopes). Ideal-observer belief adds almost nothing once trial history is in (belief x a1S1u adds <0.01). Test R^2 beyond timing 0.39, which matches the all-observed reference (0.39) and is 80% of the all ceiling (0.49). The earlier policy-based explanation used the model policy decile (0.26 alone), so going observed-only loses little here.
